quote: That building full of machinery that takes in and digests news and reports from all the planets in the galaxy, indexes it to every category it can possibly relate, then files it.
claim_description: A galaxy-wide automated news-gathering, categorizing and archival computer that can be queried for information such as spaceship data.
concept_description: A machine that stores very large collections of records or documents and finds the items matching a query in seconds.
milestone_summary: Lockheed's interactive Dialog system (Roger Summit) was tested on NASA's STAR database at Ames in 1966, cutting searches from 14 hours to a few minutes; this became NASA RECON.

quote: The Menograph, or mind-writer.
claim_description: Duplicate mention of the thought-recording device; already captured.
concept_description: A machine that writes down a person's thoughts as text, or shows their mental images or dreams on a screen.
milestone_summary: Chang and Makin at UCSF decoded spoken sentences from ECoG signals into text with 3% word error rate.

quote: Is the camera-eye, telephone-ear to be supplemented by a dynamo head, put on locomotive lungs and stood on wheel feet?
claim_description: Speculates about an electrically powered artificial human built from machine parts such as camera eyes, telephone ears, a dynamo head and locomotive lungs.
concept_description: A robot with a human-shaped body that walks, talks and handles objects in human surroundings.
milestone_summary: Westinghouse's Elektro (built 1937-38) shown at the 1939 New York World's Fair; walked by voice command, spoke about 700 words, moved head and arms.

quote: They brought a three-dimensional map out of the air, I guess; I couldn't tell. It hung in the air like it was glued to nothingness.
claim_description: Free-floating three-dimensional holographic-style maps projected in mid-air.
concept_description: A display that shows images, maps or people as volumetric three-dimensional pictures viewable from several sides.
milestone_summary: Lloyd Cross produced a hologram recreating a moving 3-dimensional image (Multiplex hologram, viewable around a cylinder)

quote: Then, activating another instrument, His Loftiness thought at it, in an entirely different vein
claim_description: Robot-like mechanical beings communicate by radiated thought and remotely control fleets of unmanned ships.
concept_description: A link from the brain's electrical signals to a machine, so that a person controls devices by thought alone.
milestone_summary: Kennedy and Bakay implanted a locked-in patient, Johnny Ray, who learned to control a computer cursor.

quote: Since real women could not go to them, scientists on Earth developed substitutes. Android females were developed, the surrogates, and shipped to the colonies.
claim_description: Female android sex surrogates are manufactured and shipped to lonely colonists on distant worlds.
concept_description: A robot built to provide companionship, affection, romance or sex.
milestone_summary: AIBO ERS-110 went on sale and sold out in 20 minutes

quote: his 250-dollar Hawthorne Electric Stepsaver door mike following him with its mindless snout. He punched a button on the chair and the 600-dollar hi-fi selected a random tape.
claim_description: Household appliances with voice and tracking microphones plus a chair-controlled hi-fi that autonomously selects tapes.
concept_description: A machine that recognizes spoken words and carries out spoken commands, such as voice-operated doors or computers.
milestone_summary: The Apricot Portable shipped with voice-command recognition (up to 4096 words, 64 in RAM at a time).
